I don't see that this has been clearly stated anywhere and I wanted to get a clarification. 

When you play a card, the rules say to activate any text on that card. Where I am unclear is when you play a card with a power.  Do you 1) play the card and activate the power THEN move to power phase, or do you 2) play the card THEN move to power phase where you may use the power? I have been playing using interpretation #2 since a power should be different than a oneshot but I wanted to clarify and be sure I wasn't putting myself at a disadvantage.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Yes, and if you're playing the Adept and you bring one of his song ongoings into play (Harmonies, Melodies, or Rhythms), you wouldn't activate their texts either as they can only be activated by stuff that causes Perform or Accompany texts to activate (his base power, instruments, or Silver Shadow one-shot). Note that in this case the song effects aren't powers so if you have the ability to use more than one power in a turn and use two different powers which can activate the same song, you can do this :).
